text: I wouldn't even give it one star. The first impression at the counter was the worst; the staff acted like they were constantly angry at their husbands. I waited a short time for braces, but the dentist was grumpy and didn't dare ask any questions. The dentist's assistant was inexperienced, talked a lot, but couldn't answer patient questions well. The dentist was heavy-handed with the braces, making it seem like they were going to knock my teeth out. There were always excess wires or poorly attached rubber bands that scratched my mouth, causing sores. On my first visit, the dentist even told me I looked ugly. They lacked ethics and manners, and offered no consultation before starting treatment. They should close the clinic and stop misleading people with their terrible promotions. I paid 1,000 baht for teeth cleaning, but it was like they hired a freshman doctor. What's good about this clinic? They should either improve it or close it down. Don't open a clinic with such bad ethics. Anyone considering coming here should read the reviews on Google Maps; everyone says the same thing – it's terrible. Read other people's reviews first.

My mom recommended getting a tooth filled here. The dentist has a gentle touch and provides excellent explanations. The staff at the counter are friendly.
The shop is clean, and they offer free dental services with the gold card. I'll be bringing my child here again.

On January 23, 2069, at approximately 11:50 AM, I went for service. Upon arrival, the counter staff were unfriendly, rude, and spoke abruptly without politeness or courtesy. In short, I couldn't use my social security insurance; it had failed. I inquired at another clinic, and they said the system had failed about two days prior, instead of calling to inform me. This wasted my time. Ultimately, I wasn't able to have my tooth extracted that day.
I'm usually terrified of dentists, but at Meeemouth, the dentist was kind and calm, which made me feel relaxed and not scared at all. I highly recommend them!

Terrible!
The clinic said they were accepting Gold Card patients. I made an appointment and they called to confirm the appointment. But when the day came, they said I couldn't use my rights because it hadn't been completed for a year.
I called 1330 to check my rights myself, and they said I was eligible for treatment right away. There was no rule that required me to wait more than a year since my last visit. I could get dental treatment three times a year. 1330 also said that this clinic branch doesn't participate in the Gold Card program.

The orthodontic treatment here is terrible. My front teeth are spaced apart, and they didn't straighten the teeth behind my molars. I didn't know at first; I only found out when I went to another clinic for a retainer. The dentist has no ethics whatsoever. They initially quoted 35,000 baht. In the end, I had 6 years of treatment, paying 1,500 baht a month for the first 6 months and 1,000 baht a month for the remaining time. It felt like they were just prolonging the treatment; the doctor's mood was erratic, as if I was getting treatment for free. They were very harsh with patients. When a bracket came off, instead of replacing it, they gave me the old one. I'm so confused; I paid for it, I should have received a new one. Think carefully before getting treatment here.

text:
I originally had gaps between my teeth, but didn't want braces. I consulted a dentist, who recommended clear aligners. The price was 49,000 baht, payable in 10 installments. I decided to go with it because I don't have much time, I wouldn't need frequent visits, and the braces wouldn't be visible. The entire treatment took about 4 months, and now my teeth are close together.
I'm about to get my retainers made.

The prices here are reasonable, and the quality is good. The dentist is skilled, explains things well and clearly, and informs you about the costs beforehand. The filling and scaling process was gentle and painless.

Parking is convenient.

Very bad. Walked into the store and the cashier didn't greet me. Plus, they brought their child to take care of during work hours. The doctor is inexperienced. The filling was very weak. When I went home, it fell out and didn't last the day. The doctor's assistant talked a lot, which was annoying. He asked questions on behalf of the doctor even though I was asking the doctor. The store is not professional. This is the second time I've received terrible quality and service from this place. Run away.

I had a filling done three days ago and the material came out. They told me to go back for a replacement, free of charge. That was acceptable. But now, a month later, more fillings are falling out. I won't go back there again, even though I had orthodontic treatment there before.

I had my braces done at this clinic when it had its old name.

1. Regarding the braces:
My upper teeth weren't properly aligned, and my four lower front teeth weren't straight either, yet they wanted me to remove the braces. What was the rush?

2. Regarding the service:
The counter staff looked like they were arguing with their husband; they were always grumpy and spoke rudely. If you're not ready to provide good service, don't come here.

3. Regarding the orthodontist:
The dentist in the extraction room was nice, friendly, and approachable.
❗️But, but, but... the orthodontist was extremely condescending towards patients. Their speech was incredibly harsh and unprofessional.

After my braces were finished and I received my retainer, I never went back to that clinic. They told me to go back for adjustments. Who wants to go back after experiencing that?

If you're thinking of getting braces done at this clinic, run away!

A friend recommended this clinic for my dentures. She said it wasn't expensive and the dentist gave great advice, so I decided to try it. I'm very happy with my experience. The dentist gave excellent advice. I had six upper dentures and three lower dentures made. I went about three times, and the price was affordable, payable in three installments. After getting the dentures, I experienced some pain when chewing, so I called the clinic to schedule an appointment. The dentist adjusted them free of charge. I went for two more adjustments, and the pain subsided. Now they work perfectly. Initially, chewing was difficult, but following the dentist's instructions made it much better. Thank you so much, dentist!

text:
I got my braces done with Dr. O. I found her on YouTube and came to her clinic. She's very kind and gives great advice. Everything is easy to understand, and you can ask questions anytime. I had crowded teeth, so I opted for braces without extractions, but I did need to have four wisdom teeth removed. Dr. O had them extracted on a Friday, and it was very quick. Next month, Dr. O said she'll take impressions for my retainers and I can choose which type to get.

Some of the assistants are lovely, while others don't smile much. Appointment confirmations are sent via LINE, but sometimes they're slow to respond.

The waiting list for dental work can be inconsistent, with some delays. This might be because I went on a Tuesday, so the queue wasn't too long. However, there can be longer waits during peak hours after work.

During the oral cleaning, fillings, and scaling, Dr. O had her braces put on the same day. She was very gentle with her fillings and scaling. I used my social security insurance, which covered 900 baht.

Overall, I think it's okay for me. The price is reasonable, the service is decent, and the doctor is lovely.

Hello! I've had fillings done at this clinic several times now. ❤️🙂 I usually schedule appointments through their Facebook page; it's very easy with an admin always responding. You can also call to schedule an appointment, but I prefer this method. 🔅🔅

Upon arrival, the staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. What I especially liked was the free consultation! 😁😁
Ultimately, I still needed fillings because the cavity was deep. 😅
The dentist gave excellent advice. 🥰

I was able to use my social security benefits, so I didn't have to pay upfront. Overall, based on my experience, I highly recommend this clinic! 👍

text: I got my braces done here. Initially, I went to other clinics, but they wouldn't accept me because my lower teeth weren't visible when I smiled. I consulted with three different clinics; some suggested surgery, others recommended implanting four anchors. Then a friend recommended this place, so I decided to try it. The doctor said it was possible and highly recommends it. The doctor is skilled, the price is reasonable with payment plans, and the waiting list isn't too long. There might be a shorter wait if the doctor needs scaling or fillings.

Let's go through each point:
Starting with 1. The Orthodontist:
1.1. Their communication skills were terrible. Their mood was erratic, like …

Terrible service. I've been getting braces for almost three years now and they never explain anything to the patients. A senior once warned me that they didn't do a good job here, but I didn't believe them and wanted to try it myself. When I experienced it myself, I was deeply moved. Everyone commented on my appearance and my teeth being crooked. One day, I had the opportunity to ask the dentist, "Doctor, my teeth are crooked. Everyone says they're not beautiful." The dentist and assistant replied, "My teeth are protruding, so that's why they're like this." Well, if there's no problem, why would I want braces? I asked if there was a way to fix it. The dentist replied, "You can do a little touch-up," and then moved my appointment up two weeks to keep my appointment. I'll come back and review it once it's done. If you're going to get braces at this clinic, I recommend going elsewhere. Don't waste your time.

I feel terrible. I've been wearing braces for over two years and nothing has changed. They keep pulling my teeth left and right, they're never aligned even once. I have gaps between my teeth. Some months they even pull my lower teeth over my upper teeth. The dentist even asked me, "Why are your lower teeth overlapping your upper teeth?" Wait, shouldn't I be the one asking that? The dentist in the extraction room is nice, but the orthodontist is in a bad mood for no reason. They rarely say anything, they have a grumpy face, and they hit my mouth with their instruments very often. At first, they did a great job and my teeth were beautifully aligned, but lately I can't even bite through a noodle. If you're looking for a clinic, I'm telling you, don't come here. Don't be fooled into coming here. The clinic doesn't look clean at all, especially the X-ray room, it's full of all sorts of stuff.

From firsthand experience, I had to move to another orthodontic clinic two years ago. No matter how I tried, my lower teeth overlapped my upper teeth. They were spaced apart, and they'd never been straightened, not even once. Wherever I went, people thought my teeth were crooked. The clinic looked unclean and unwelcome, both inside and outside. I took my girlfriend to get a retainer for 3,500 baht. I'd fixed it over and over again, but it still wouldn't fit. Not only was I wasted money, but I felt bad. People who do good things are also happy because every day the dentist is different. If you're lucky, the dentist is beautiful and good. But personally, I saw the dentist on Saturday. Where else can I get my lower teeth overlapping my upper teeth? I asked the patient if he was the one who had this name and why his lower teeth overlapped his upper teeth? The dentist frowned. I don't know what's wrong. If you're looking at this place, run away.

I've been wearing braces for 4 years, starting with just one chipped tooth. Now my teeth are crooked and spaced apart. I can't take it anymore. Especially since I've already paid in full. The service is terrible, the doctor is rude, and there's no guidance given to the patient. When my teeth became crooked, they blamed me for chewing on only one side! Well, the doctor didn't say anything! Tell me which side I should chew on! Advise me! Of course I chew on my preferred side! It's absolutely awful! When they wanted me to start treatment, they were incredibly nice.

- The orthodontic treatment was effective, taking 2.5 years to complete, but...
- During the treatment, I couldn't ask the doctor many questions. The doctor's temper flared up very quickly, likely because they own the clinic.
Sometimes they seemed unable to control their emotions. It's unbelievable that I witnessed this with multiple patients.
- Regarding the clinic's chat responses,
both the owner (the doctor) and staff responded.

On one occasion, the response was extremely impolite.
- There were several errors during the retainer production process. Due to various workflows, multiple re-taking impressions were required. This should have been evident from the start, as the clinic's impressions were deemed incomplete. Unable to tolerate the delays and the impolite behavior, I canceled the retainer order due to the clinic's mistakes and opted to have my retainer made elsewhere.
I found that the retainers from the other clinic
were of much higher quality, had better service, and a much better service mindset than here.
- Some clinics now have their own labs, resulting in better retainers, faster service, higher standards, and lower prices. They are also cleaner and more modern. The service is much better, and they have a much better service-minded attitude. I recommend anyone considering braces and needing a retainer to go elsewhere; you'll have much more peace of mind.

Terrible service. My filling fell out, and they said this time they have to be more meticulous. What?! Was it this sloppy the first time I went?

Appointments are never scheduled; even when I arrive, I never get my work done on time. Why even offer appointments?

Most recently, they said I had to wait an hour. After two hours, I asked how many people were ahead of me, and they said it still wasn't finished. They told me to schedule another appointment. Disgusting.

One more thing: their Facebook page doesn't get any negative reviews because they delete all the negative posts and comments.

I had a dental appointment and called beforehand to ask if I could get a filling done due to the COVID-19 situation. They said yes. But when I got to the counter, they said no. It was a complete waste of time, money, and I'm extremely disappointed with this clinic. If any of my friends are looking for dental work or braces, find another clinic and don't come here. Consider yourself warned!

The dentists who extracted my teeth were all good and spoke nicely, except for the orthodontist who spoke terribly. They were rough, and could have told the patients nicely. If they spoke better, more people would probably want to go there.

If all the staff, including the dentist, could provide better smile service, please be more attentive and explain the treatment plan every time I visit. It's confusing when they just send you out to pay after the treatment is finished. I'm not sure what stage my dental work is at. Please be more attentive to your customers. 😎 …

When we went, we saw a female dentist who had a filling done. She was very gentle and gave good advice.

Why drag out this case? The braces keep coming off, the teeth aren't being pulled properly, and the dentist and assistant provide terrible service. They never give any advice and act annoyed when you ask questions. Don't come to this clinic. If you could choose another clinic, it would be better.

The counter staff, a short, blonde woman with short hair, was incredibly rude. I was giving her money, and she should have had better manners in responding to customers.
Her responses on LINE were also terrible; she didn't use polite language like "ka" or "kha," and her tone was awful.
I've endured braces for years, and now I'm dealing with this terrible management.

The installment payment process wasn't great either. Once you've paid in full, that's it; they make excuses about whether the teeth are properly aligned or not. It's so frustrating. And judging from the reviews, all the 5-star ratings are for the dentist's assistants.
Affordable braces with installment payment options. Teeth cleaning and braces put on right away, great! Very fast, fillings and teeth cleaning done quickly, braces put on right away. I love it!
